none: PAS LVPL-0FBD20: Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ is CONSTANTINUS AVG ; R/ is D N CONSTANTINI MAX AVG

A Roman copper alloy nummus of Constantine I dating to the period AD 323 to 324 (Reece Period 16). Reverse type D N CONSTANTINI MAX AVG (VOT XX in wreath). Cf RIC VII p202, no.439. Mint of Trier. The diameter is 17mm, and the weight is 2.5g. Obverse inscription is CONSTANTINUS AVG and the reverse inscription is D N CONSTANTINI MAX AVG
